faq.q: What does a video ad generator produce?
faq.a: A spoken ad from a product photo or a product page, with a script, an AI actor, and a voice. You pick from 53 AI actors. You do not film a set.

faq.q: How does a shop build the video ad?
faq.a: Start with the insulated bottle photo or its page. Approve the drafted sentence, change a word when the bottle differs, then download. You can edit captions, swap the voice, or add a track from the music library before you post.

faq.q: Which tool should a shop use for paid ads?
faq.a: Use one built for ads you can run: a script, an AI actor, a voice, and the sizes TikTok and Meta expect. AIVideosUGC does that from a photo or a product link, including a batch of products.

faq.q: Do I pay before I can make the first ad?
faq.a: Yes. You pick a paid plan, then make the first ad from the bottle photo. Starter is $24.50 a month for 200 credits, Pro is $35 for 300, and Premium is $63 for 600.

faq.q: Are commercial rights included on a paid plan?
faq.a: Yes. On a paid plan the clip can be the ad you fund. The file has no watermark, and you do not need a separate creator license.

faq.q: Which frame sizes and placements can the file use?
faq.a: A phone ad wants 9:16, and a square feed wants 1:1. 16:9, 4:3, and 3:4 are there when the placement asks. You can download the file or send it toward TikTok, Meta, or Google Ads.

faq.q: Can every product in the catalog get its own ad?
faq.a: Yes. Each product can get an ad from its own photo or page. Shop software you already use can send that list. Every clip still spends credits, and a failed job returns them.

faq.q: How do these compare with ads filmed by creators?
faq.a: Book a creator when you need a person filmed with the product itself. Use the generated ad when you are still choosing which opening to buy. Results depend on the product and the audience, so test more than one opening.

faq.q: Will Meta or TikTok reject a generated clip?
faq.a: Read that ad account's current rule before you fund the clip. If a viewer could think a buyer filmed their own order, add the label that account asks for. Keep the scene true to the insulated bottle you uploaded.

steps.sourceAlt: Your product: an insulated bottle shown alone on a pure white background.
steps.prompt: Use your product photo and keep its shape, color and label the same. Show one person using the product in a familiar place, then hold it up clearly. Light it like a phone video and keep the camera steady. Keep the sound of the action and the room. No words, logos or music.
